basic_info.description: Fall in love with this splendid 1930s single-family home in sunny Mission Terrace! Filled with character,this bright 2-bedroom retreat features spacious rooms,great flow,a stunning kitchen,formal dining room, breakfast room and elegant living room, plus an extra family room or potential 3rd bedroom. All on a quiet, sought-after block! Infused with natural light. Handsome, newly refinished hardwood floors. Period details and modern updates. Large living room with high ceilings, gorgeous gas fireplace and bay windows. Classic-design kitchen has stone countertops and plentiful cabinet space. French doors open to center patio.Two quiet, roomy bedrooms at the rear, overlooking the garden. Downstairs is a fabulous family room, 3rd bedroom or home office Oversized garage with room for 2 cars, workshop and development potential. Luscious, flat yard and garden and decked area. Walk to Cayuga Park; enjoy one of SF's nicest microclimates. Commuters dream with easy access to 280, Balboa Bart Station and MUNI.
